data.creator_notes:
Translated with AI (DeepSeek Reasoner). I've been seeing some very interesting Chinese-language bots right up my alley recently, and if you've seen Beth's bloated description, you know what I mean. This one's a little more bimbo-oriented than I usually lean, but it's nice and has some fun quirks. Minimal changes made, one {{user}}/{{char}} slip-up corrected, multiple translations made of each section with various levels of localization. There are some changes I personally would make, but I wanted to translate it as directly as possible. If GodofAI has a problem with this translation, please let me know.

One point of confusion for me - the brainwashing lorebook entry. I assume this is to be used when playing to track individual or global mental changes manually. 🤷

I'll probably do a few more of these, I've got several lined up (but this one took priority as it's most to my tastes). I have a few of my own cooking too, but you all know I go at my own pace, so don't hold your breath. DeepSeek Reasoner rules.
